style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render set in an empty pure white space. People are smooth faceless figurines with no eyes, nose or mouth details, told apart only by clothes, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and light gray colors; only the key objects (the balloons) are red. The setting is Cleveland, Ohio, USA, on the shore of Lake Erie, in 1986.
avoid_en: logos, emblems, badges or patches of real companies, groups, agencies or the coast guard, any readable text, letters or numbers anywhere (all signs, papers, screens, boats and shirts are blank), national flags, blood, injuries, faces resembling real people, split panels or comic frames

staff.desc_en: the organizer, a faceless man figurine in his thirties with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short curly brown hair, plain red windbreaker without any print, khaki trousers, white sneakers

students.desc_en: teenage volunteer figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain white t-shirts without any print, blue jeans, various short hairstyles

fishers.desc_en: two faceless middle-aged man figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details): one in a plain yellow raincoat and plain gray cap, the other in a plain orange raincoat and plain dark-blue cap, both in dark trousers and rubber boots

guard.desc_en: rescue crew figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain navy jackets with no patches or badges, orange life vests with no text, dark trousers

cuts.image: 赤い上着の男のフィギュアが、腕時計を見ながら片手を上げて合図している
cuts.image_en: The organizer figurine in a plain red windbreaker checks a plain wristwatch and raises one hand high to give a signal. Behind him the huge net box full of balloons. A dark cloud on the horizon.
cuts.en: The organizer figurine in a plain red windbreaker checks a plain wristwatch and raises one hand high to give a signal. Behind him the huge net box full of balloons. A dark cloud on the horizon.

cuts.image: 足場の箱の網がはずされ、風船が一斉に上へ飛び出し始める
cuts.image_en: The top net of the huge scaffolding box is pulled away, and a massive column of red and white balloons begins to burst upward out of the box into the sky. The crowd figurines below raise their arms.
cuts.en: The top net of the huge scaffolding box is pulled away, and a massive column of red and white balloons begins to burst upward out of the box into the sky. The crowd figurines below raise their arms.

cuts.image: 広場から、赤と白の風船の巨大な柱が空へ伸びている
cuts.image_en: From the city square diorama, a gigantic tower of red and white balloons rises into the sky, taller than the office buildings. Tiny crowds below. Majestic wide view.
cuts.en: From the city square diorama, a gigantic tower of red and white balloons rises into the sky, taller than the office buildings. Tiny crowds below. Majestic wide view.

cuts.image: 赤い上着の男のフィギュアが、両手を上げて空の風船を見上げている
cuts.image_en: The organizer figurine in a plain red windbreaker raises both arms in joy, looking up at a sky full of red and white balloons. Bright moment.
cuts.en: The organizer figurine in a plain red windbreaker raises both arms in joy, looking up at a sky full of red and white balloons. Bright moment.

cuts.image: 空に上がった風船の雲が、雨雲にぶつかって横に広がり、下に垂れ始める
cuts.image_en: Over the miniature city, the huge cloud of red and white balloons meets a dark gray rain cloud and spreads sideways, starting to sag downward. Rain streaks begin. Dramatic, uneasy mood.
cuts.en: Over the miniature city, the huge cloud of red and white balloons meets a dark gray rain cloud and spreads sideways, starting to sag downward. Rain streaks begin. Dramatic, uneasy mood.

cuts.image: 雨のしずくが当たった赤い風船が、ふくらんだまま下へ沈んでいく
cuts.image_en: Close view: several red balloons, still fully inflated, covered in cold rain droplets, are being pushed down toward gray rooftops below. Rain streaks.
cuts.en: Close view: several red balloons, still fully inflated, covered in cold rain droplets, are being pushed down toward gray rooftops below. Rain streaks.

cuts.image: 風に流される風船の群れが、街の模型から湖の上へ広がっていく
cuts.image_en: A swarm of red and white balloons is blown sideways by strong wind, streaming from the miniature city out over a wide gray lake. Rain and wind streaks.
cuts.en: A swarm of red and white balloons is blown sideways by strong wind, streaming from the miniature city out over a wide gray lake. Rain and wind streaks.

cuts.image: 滑走路で作業員のフィギュアたちが、赤い風船を大きな袋に拾い集めている
cuts.image_en: On the gray airport runway diorama, worker figurines in plain orange vests with no text pick up red balloons and stuff them into big plain gray bags. Light rain.
cuts.en: On the gray airport runway diorama, worker figurines in plain orange vests with no text pick up red balloons and stuff them into big plain gray bags. Light rain.

cuts.image: 湖ぞいの道で、無地の車が数台つながって止まり、まわりに赤い風船
cuts.image_en: A lakeside highway diorama in light rain: a line of about ten plain 1980s cars without logos or plates has bumped into each other in a chain and stopped. Red balloons lie on the road around them. No people hurt, no damage details.
cuts.en: A lakeside highway diorama in light rain: a line of about ten plain 1980s cars without logos or plates has bumped into each other in a chain and stopped. Red balloons lie on the road around them. No people hurt, no damage details.

cuts.image: 緑の牧場の模型で、白い馬が前足を上げて驚き、まわりに赤い風船が落ちている
cuts.image_en: A small green pasture diorama with a white wooden fence. A white Arabian horse rears up in fright, front legs high, as red balloons drop onto the grass around it. No people.
cuts.en: A small green pasture diorama with a white wooden fence. A white Arabian horse rears up in fright, front legs high, as red balloons drop onto the grass around it. No people.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、裁判所の小槌と、小さな馬の模型が並ぶ
cuts.image_en: In the white space, a wooden judge's gavel lies on its block next to a small white horse figurine. Plain and quiet. No text.
cuts.en: In the white space, a wooden judge's gavel lies on its block next to a small white horse figurine. Plain and quiet. No text.

cuts.image: 遠い砂浜の模型に、しぼんだ赤い風船がたくさん打ち上げられている
cuts.image_en: A small sandy beach diorama on a calm gray lake: many deflated, wrinkled red and white balloons lie washed up along the shoreline among pebbles and driftwood. No people.
cuts.en: A small sandy beach diorama on a calm gray lake: many deflated, wrinkled red and white balloons lie washed up along the shoreline among pebbles and driftwood. No people.

cuts.image: 夕方の湖の模型を、小さな木のボートが進む。黄色い雨がっぱの男が2人乗っている
cuts.image_en: A gray lake diorama at dusk. A small wooden fishing boat with an outboard motor heads out from a stone breakwall. Two faceless middle-aged man figurines sit in it: one in a plain yellow raincoat and a plain gray cap, one in a plain orange raincoat and a plain dark-blue cap, holding fishing rods.
cuts.en: A gray lake diorama at dusk. A small wooden fishing boat with an outboard motor heads out from a stone breakwall. Two faceless middle-aged man figurines sit in it: one in a plain yellow raincoat and a plain gray cap, one in a plain orange raincoat and a plain dark-blue cap, holding fishing rods.

cuts.image: 白い空間に置かれた、小さな木の釣りボートの模型を横から
cuts.image_en: Side view of a small plain wooden fishing boat model with an outboard motor, about five meters long, placed on the white floor. Two fishing rods lean on its seat. No text or numbers on the boat.
cuts.en: Side view of a small plain wooden fishing boat model with an outboard motor, about five meters long, placed on the white floor. Two fishing rods lean on its seat. No text or numbers on the boat.

cuts.image: 夜の湖、高い波。遠くに小さなボートの影
cuts.image_en: A dark night lake diorama with high rough waves and heavy wind. Far away, the small silhouette of a tiny fishing boat tossed on the waves. Cold blue light. No people visible clearly.
cuts.en: A dark night lake diorama with high rough waves and heavy wind. Far away, the small silhouette of a tiny fishing boat tossed on the waves. Cold blue light. No people visible clearly.

cuts.image: 朝の家の模型の玄関で、女性のフィギュアが電話の受話器を持っている
cuts.image_en: A small 1980s house diorama in the morning with the front wall removed: inside, a faceless woman figurine in a plain cardigan holds a corded telephone receiver to her ear, standing by the kitchen. Worried mood.
cuts.en: A small 1980s house diorama in the morning with the front wall removed: inside, a faceless woman figurine in a plain cardigan holds a corded telephone receiver to her ear, standing by the kitchen. Worried mood.

cuts.image: 湖の上を、紺の上着の隊員が乗った小さな船と、白いヘリコプターが進む

cuts.en: A gray lake diorama: a small plain dark-blue rescue boat with figurines in plain navy jackets and orange life vests (no patches) moves across the water, and a small plain white helicopter with no markings flies above it.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、浮き輪とロープと小さな救助艇の模型
cuts.image_en: In the white space, a plain orange-and-white life ring, a coiled rope and a small plain rescue boat model are arranged neatly. No text or emblems.
cuts.en: In the white space, a plain orange-and-white life ring, a coiled rope and a small plain rescue boat model are arranged neatly. No text or emblems.

cuts.image: 捜索の船の上から、赤い風船が雨のように降ってくる
cuts.image_en: Above the small dark-blue rescue boat on the gray lake, red and white balloons rain down from the sky. The figurines in navy jackets look up. Rain streaks.
cuts.en: Above the small dark-blue rescue boat on the gray lake, red and white balloons rain down from the sky. The figurines in navy jackets look up. Rain streaks.

cuts.en: Top-down view of a gray lake surface completely covered by tens of thousands of floating red and white balloons, packed edge to edge. A tiny rescue boat is a small dot among them.

cuts.image: 船の上から双眼鏡で水面を見る隊員。水面には丸い風船ばかり

cuts.en: A figurine in a plain navy jacket and orange life vest looks through binoculars from the edge of the rescue boat at the lake surface, which is full of round floating red and white balloons. Searching, worried pose.

cuts.en: A small plain white helicopter model with no markings flies through a dense swarm of floating red and white balloons in the gray sky, like flying through an asteroid field.

cuts.en: Daytime view of a gray lake by a stone breakwall, its surface covered by floating red and white balloons. Overcast sky. No boat, no people.

cuts.image: 嵐の夜の同じ湖。風船は1つも無く、空っぽのボートだけが波に揺れている（前の絵 F07a から切り替える）
